Join Arvato in Heijen and play a key role in keeping global supply chains moving. Work in an international environment, solve daily challenges, and help deliver outstanding service to customers around the world. What will make you successful in this role? You are organized, customer-focused, and comfortable working in a fast-paced logistics environment. You enjoy working with different stakeholders and can easily switch between administrative and operational tasks. We're looking for someone who has: Experience working with SAP ERP and SAP EWM Experience in a customer service or logistics support role Strong Microsoft Excel skills A background in logistics, supply chain, or warehousing is an advantage A strong command of English Good communication and organizational skills A proactive and solution-oriented mindset Dutch language skills are a plus but not required. Ready for your next challenge? Looking for a position where customer service and logistics come together? Join Arvato in Heijen and make a difference in an international operation that keeps global supply chains moving. Apply today and become part of the Arvato team. What do we offer? At Arvato, you'll join a global logistics organization that values development, teamwork, and long-term growth. You'll have the opportunity to build your experience in an international environment while contributing to the success of world-leading brands. As a Customer Service Officer at Arvato, you are at the heart of the logistics operation. You ensure shipments move smoothly, customers stay informed, and logistics processes run efficiently. No two days are the same 

you coordinate with customers, carriers, drivers, and warehouse teams in an international and fast-paced environment. Combining administration, communication, and problem-solving, you'll play a key role in delivering an excellent customer experience while keeping operations on track. Your responsibilities: Coordinate inbound and outbound shipments and ensure all administrative processes are completed accurately Welcome and assist drivers at the driver desk, ensuring efficient arrivals and departures Manage, maintain, and digitise logistics documentation Communicate with customers, carriers, and internal teams via phone, email, and in person Support daily warehouse administration and operational activities Work with SAP ERP and SAP EWM systems to monitor logistics processes Ensure accurate data management and process control Proactively identify bottlenecks and resolve operational challenges
